capabilities: Highlight proofreading findings in the note, colour-coded by category
Show the rule behind each finding on hover
Fix findings in place via a correction field, or resolve or dismiss them
List all findings for the open note in a panel
Run the Claude Code proofread skill from the plugin on desktop
disambiguation: It does not proofread anything itself; it only draws the findings report that a Claude Code skill writes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Findings render only in Source and Live Preview, not Reading view. Reports are stored as JSON under a dot-prefixed .proofread/ folder, and anything that writes that JSON format can serve as the report writer.
motivation: The author built it so findings are drawn on the note itself, letting you work through them where the prose is rather than in a chat log.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in proofreading, and running checks in a chat log or separate report means editing prose away from the text itself.

relations.evidence: It draws a report that the proofread skill for Claude Code, which lives in this repo, writes.

summary: Proofreading overlay that highlights grammar, vocabulary, clutter and clarity findings in a note and lets you fix each one in place.
